After centuries of believing the Loch Ness Monster dwells deep within Scotland's Loch Ness, a new theory paints a different story; experts explore evidence suggesting the monster may not only be real, but possibly more dangerous than ever imagined.

title: Most Terrifying With Jason Hawes
description:
S01 E01 — Blood Is Thicker Than Water
Jason Hawes uncovers haunted ruins forever stalked by restless spirits and malevolent creatures, including an abandoned amusement park, a sinister grain silo and a long-shuttered subterranean factory.

title: Most Terrifying With Jason Hawes
description:
S01 E02 — Ride to Hell
A menacing medieval castle, a gilded opera house turned makeshift morgue, and a terrifying train car straight out of a nightmare are all the dire domain of the undead according to Jason Hawes.

title: Most Terrifying With Jason Hawes
description:
S01 E03 — Prison of the Dead
Jason Hawes knows there's no rest for the wicked. Long-dead prisoners prowl an old English jail, a decommissioned warship is haunted by the agonized victims of a grisly tragedy, and sinister spirits roam the upper floor of a historic building.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E08 — Kreischer Mansion
Katrina takes Jack to Kreischer Mansion in Staten Island, N.Y., where a past paranormal experience left her searching for answers; a new spirit has taken up residence since Katrina's last visit, but it may not be who the new owners think it is.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E03 — Taylor Trask Museum
Jack Osbourne and Katrina Weidman head to Plymouth, Mass., to investigate the historic Taylor Trask Museum; the caretaker, Jan, wants to calm the restless spirits, but with the recent uptick in paranormal activity, she fears for her safety.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E01 — Hill View Manor
Jack and Katrina travel to Hill View Manor in New Castle, Pa., a shuttered nursing home where former patients are rumored to live on in death, and they cross paths with the Creeper, an evil shadow creature bent on tormenting its victims.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E05 — Fort Mifflin
Katrina Weidman takes Jack Osbourne to one of her favorite hotspots; Philadelphia's Fort Mifflin is a location rife with the ghosts of wars long past.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E02 — Eloise Psychiatric Hospital
Jack Osbourne and Katrina Weidman investigate Eloise Psychiatric Hospital in Detroit, Mich.; once known for its cutting-edge facilities, Eloise is notorious for its aggressive spirits and is host to a dark entity that delights in choking its victims.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E12 — Pamplin Historical Park
Katrina and Jack arrive in Petersburg, Va., to explore a bloody Civil War battlefield; they expect the echoes of forgotten voices but soon find that the intelligent spirits roaming the land desperately want to make themselves known.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E04 — Savannah Theatre
Katrina Weidman and Jack Osbourne investigate the Savannah Theatre in Savannah, Ga., a paranormal playhouse dating back almost 200 years; the duo takes the stage and discovers that this theater likes to put on a horror show.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E07 — Malco Theatre
Jack and Katrina investigate a live magic venue in the bubbling resort town of Hot Springs, Ark.; in a location charged by strange geothermal forces, not all phenomena in this former movie palace appears to be the trick of a magician.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E06 — Missouri State Penitentiary
The team heads to the infamous Missouri State Penitentiary in Jefferson City, Mo.; with a history of suffering and violence that goes back over a century, Jack Osbourne and Katrina Weidman look to finally unlock what may be haunting this location.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E09 — Ernestine and Hazel's
Jack and Katrina investigate a Memphis, Tenn., blues bar with a sordid past; the team seeks to help a former bartender confront both the light and dark forces haunting the mysterious music hall.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E10 — Victoria's Black Swan Inn
Jack and Katrina travel to San Antonio to investigate the site of a key battle in the Texas revolution, but when a malevolent energy targets Katrina, the team quickly learns this will be no ordinary investigation.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E11 — Hotel Paisano
The mysterious town of Marfa, Texas, is Jack and Katrina's next stop as the team investigates the Hotel Paisano, a well-known paranormal hot spot, but without known incidences of death on the property, they have their work cut out for them.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E13 — The Enchanted Church
Jack is called to Sycamore, Ohio, to investigate the Enchanted Church, owned by Jack's former nanny and his wife; the couple needs Jack's help to determine if the paranormal activity they're experiencing is holy or hellish.
